work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent act XIX begins with synopsis 16890–16895, protocol 16898–16899 and incipit 16901. All five sections of the present privilege communication are printed, including the substantive grant through 17147; references to privileges of other orders are the operative incorporation language of the act itself. Preserves historical note 16915–16919, corrections 16974–16975, the historical possible-lacuna warning at 17024 and syntax notes 17122–17123, together with original dating 17242–17244 and editorial dating 17246. Trims detached marginal tail 17249: its year fragment continues the marginal summary of the chapter decree in following XX at 17261–17265 and the chapter year in 17270, rather than belonging to the completed XIX. Accepted u0019 begins 17252 and is not modified; this excluded neighbouring marginal line is recorded as an integration dependency. No accepted range overlaps the proposed range.
